description: Adds a gate output of its own for every step of the 16 Step Sequencer, and is placed immediately to the right of it

outputs.text: Carries 10V for the whole of the step of that number while the sequencer is running, whatever the gate and trigger buttons on the sequencer are set to

notes: the 4 Bit Sequence Encoder also drives this expander; no other Count Modula sequencer does
a further expander placed immediately to the right of this one is fed the same sequence detail
